purpose: Tire-compound index -> name. The save stores tire_compound as ordinal*1000+idx; idx (0..15) is a GLOBAL compound-catalog position. idx 0 = Stock is data-certain. The in-game Tire Compound MENU (video-captured 2026-08-23) gives the REAL FH6 compound NAMES, but the menu grid is NOT in save-index order and only shows a car's AVAILABLE compounds, so it does NOT by itself map name->index.
names_confidence: idx 0 = Stock and idx 15 = Drift are VERIFIED from saves. Every other index->name assignment is UNVERIFIED best-effort and may be displaced the same way idx 9's 'Drift' was: anchor_compound.py now frees any unverified index claiming a name that a verified anchor has just taken, so the catalog cannot assert one compound at two indices.

observed_fh6_menu_compounds.source: In-game Tire Compound menu, 2018 Exomotive Exocet Sport V8 XP-5 (ord 2866), video knE0jOvP9z.mp4 2026-08-23. Names are exact; grid POSITION is NOT the save index.
observed_fh6_menu_compounds.note: Stock tile literally reads 'Stock Tire Compound (Slick)' -> this car's stock tyre is a slick; the My Cars pane label 'Slick Tires' = STOCK (idx 0), not an upgrade.
